---
title: 'Template Catalog'
description: 'Preset IDs loaded by the current GitAscii template registry'
---

Templates are starting layouts: widget positions, configuration and global styles. After you edit a profile, the saved widgets and styles are the publishing input. A template ID alone does not continuously reset your layout.

The registry loads 15 JSON templates plus `blank`. These are the current IDs; filenames and IDs are not always identical.

| Preset ID         | Name                        | Source file                      |
| :---------------- | :-------------------------- | :------------------------------- |
| `ascii_native`    | ASCII Native                | `ascii_native.json`              |
| `bento_grid`      | Bento Grid                  | `bento_grid.json`                |
| `codeweb`         | Code Web                    | `codeweb.json`                   |
| `dossier`         | Dossier                     | `dossier.json`                   |
| `hacker`          | Hacker                      | `hacker.json`                    |
| `mainframe`       | Mainframe                   | `mainframe.json`                 |
| `minecraft`       | Minecraft Dev Profile       | `minecraft.json`                 |
| `minimal_luxe`    | Minimal Luxe                | `minimal_luxe.json`              |
| `mission-control` | Mission Control             | `mission-control.json`           |
| `native`          | Native Terminal             | `Native.json`                    |
| `native_advanced` | Native Advanced             | `native_advanced.json`           |
| `native_simple`   | Native Simple               | `native_simple.json`             |
| `rugbedbugg`      | Surveillance Console        | `rugbedbugg.json`                |
| `andreicsantana`  | Windows XP (Andreicsantana) | `template_andreicsantana.json`   |
| `windows_xp`      | Windows XP Bliss Desktop    | `windows_xp.json`                |
| `blank`           | Blank Canvas                | Defined in `TemplateRenderer.ts` |

## Use a preset in this repository

```typescript
import { createConfiguration } from '@/engine'

const config = createConfiguration(
  githubData.user.id,
  githubData.user.login,
  'native',
  'default',
  'Default',
  githubData
)
```

Unknown IDs currently fall back to the default preset, normally `native`. This can hide a typo: `terminal`, `minimal`, `dracula` and `synthwave` are not registered preset IDs in this revision. Some similar names exist as **decoration styles**, which are a separate setting.

The HTTP `template` query is a fallback when there is no saved configuration; it does not replace a stored profile. Standard README URLs reference published files and do not accept template query overrides.

## Maintain the catalog

Add or edit a JSON file in `src/data/templates/`, then run `npm run generate:templates`. The script rebuilds `generated.ts`; do not manually maintain its imports. The loader checks IDs when constructing the registry.

Sources: [template JSON directory](https://github.com/Igorcbraz/GitAscii/tree/f248c939a3ea7810c3d3e331ae904b56a72b998f/src/data/templates), [registry generator](https://github.com/Igorcbraz/GitAscii/blob/f248c939a3ea7810c3d3e331ae904b56a72b998f/scripts/generate-template-registry.mjs), [TemplateRenderer](https://github.com/Igorcbraz/GitAscii/blob/f248c939a3ea7810c3d3e331ae904b56a72b998f/src/engine/core/TemplateRenderer.ts).
